name: Ipidacrine
summary: Ipidacrine (Neiromidin) is a drug first synthesized by the National Research Center for Biologically Active Compounds in the Russian Federation. This compound is a modification of the older drug tacrine (Cognex).

pharmacology.text: Ipidacrine is a reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor used in memory disorders of different origins. Ipidacrine directly stimulates impulse transmission in the central nervous system and neuromuscular synapses by blocking membrane potassium channels.
